name: Health Promotion
description: Interventions across sectors important for health living and wellbeing. Consult PEN and PEN+ to ensure risk factors are included

name: Disease Prevention
description: Intervention targeted at preventing the condition from occurring or limiting its severity. E.g. Measles immunization

name: Curative
description: Interventions to directly respond to the condition aimed at its resolution

name: Rehabilitative
description: Interventions aimed at managing the residual effects of the condition

name: Pallative
description: Interventions aimed at easing the death process, where other interventions have not stopped it
